mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ranking_cache ( rank_no, trip_id, score, reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{rankNo}, #{tripId}, #{score}, #{reason}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT rc.rank_no AS rankNo, rc.trip_id AS tripId, t.name AS title, t.image_url AS imageUrl, rc.score AS score, rc.reason AS reason FROM ranking_cache rc JOIN trip t ON rc.trip_id = t.trip_id ORDER BY rc.rank_no ASC
